name: Advanced Molding
about:
Advanced Molding operates two facilities in West Michigan, with its primary 53,000-square-foot plant in Grand Haven and a second site in Nunica. The company is led by President Matt Jacobs, Engineering Manager Steve Johnson, and Operations Manager Eric Jacobs.

The firm specializes in custom injection molding with press capacities ranging from 110 to 1,100 tons, supported by 6-axis and 3-axis robotics, pickers, and conveyors. Core processes include insert molding, automated part production, and a suite of value-added services such as annealing, kitting, labeling, taping, light assembly, sonic welding, and heat staking. The company also provides full product development — part design, tool and mold design, material selection, automation cell creation, and patent development — alongside manufacturing operations, quality management, and supply chain procurement.

Advanced Molding serves customers in outdoor recreation and sporting goods, home appliances and electrical components, agricultural equipment, B2B products, and light industrial parts. From its Michigan base, it ships parts domestically to locations such as Kalamazoo and Elkhart, Indiana, and internationally to Mexico and Europe.

The company emphasizes "breakthrough thinking and agile collaboration," aiming to engineer quality in and costs out through advanced technology and streamlined manufacturing. Its differentiators include in-house automation, a broad press range, and end-to-end services from concept to global delivery.
